paragraphs: Ahavah son of Rabbi Zeira: Eruvin 96b; in the Jerusalem Talmud he is called Achavah, Acha or Achaya. Rav Zutra son of Rav Zeira: Shabbat 157a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Eruvin 96b fully writes Rabbi Zeira as Ahavah’s father, while Shabbat 157a fully writes Rav Zeira as Rav Zutra’s father. These distinct full title forms support the contextual expansions in the two notices, without merging the fathers’ identities.

Eruvin 96b fully writes Rabbi Zeira as Ahavah’s father, and Shabbat 157a fully writes Rav Zeira as Rav Zutra’s father. Hyman’s unspecified Jerusalem Talmud name variants remain reported readings without an identity merge.
